title: Grid paths modulo
statementMd:
A robot at the top-left moves right or down through a grid of `0` (free) and `1` (blocked) cells to the bottom-right. Return the number of paths modulo 1000007.

**Example:** `count_paths_grid([[0, 0], [0, 0]])` returns `2`.
hints: Standard grid DP with a modulus.
